items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I used to work at the Silver Street. Listen to this. Yeah. With Cheek as the band leader. Mm-hmm. George Lewis on clarinet.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. What about, did you ever know George Lewis in the old days?

Yeah, I'll tell you about it. I used to work at the Silver Street. Listen to this. Yeah. With Cheek as the band leader. Mm-hmm. George Lewis on clarinet. Mm-hmm. Manny Gabriel on saxophone. Now it's been so long I forgot who was on the drum. But I used to work at the Silver Street. That was down in the Araby.
What were you playing? You were playing guitar then?
